description: An immutable seeded single-octave 2D gradient field with pure binary64 samples in [0,1]. Independently specified; not Processing noise compatibility.

seed.evidence: Required repeatability is a design capability; the motivating note does not establish a portable seed algorithm or preferred seed.

x.evidence: Planar scalar sampling motivated by pelines; native scaling/offset remains caller arithmetic. No useful coordinate range established.

y.evidence: Planar scalar sampling motivated by pelines; safe-corner hard bound is representability, not an artistic range.

behavior.construction: Validate exactly one seed key and mathematical integral value 0..4294967295. Integral floating values allowed, booleans rejected. Detach input; store immutable seed, normalize zero to +0. Serialize only {seed}; no derived table, cache or query history.
behavior.query_validation: Interchange query is exactly [x,y]. Validate shape then x then y. Both finite binary64 values must satisfy -9007199254740991 <= q < 9007199254740991, so floor(q) and floor(q)+1 are exact safe integers. Return no partial output on error. Native hot path sample(x,y) takes scalars and does not allocate a query tuple. The same native sample method may accept one coordinate tuple for interchange or two scalar arguments for the hot path. Invalid tuple shape is INVALID_QUERY. Unsupported native call arity is a host-language call error and is not an interchange-data result.
behavior.cells: I=floor(x), J=floor(y), retained as exact integers for corner arithmetic. u=x-floor(x), v=y-floor(y) each separately rounded binary64 subtraction. Tiny negative inputs may produce u or v equal to 1 by rounding; do not correct/reject. For hashing only, reduce each I+di,J+dj modulo 2^32. Do not cast a binary64 floor directly to signed int32; Java may convert to long then take low32 bits.
behavior.mix32: For unsigned32 v, in order: v=v XOR (v logical-right-shift 16); v=(v*0x7feb352d) modulo 2^32; v=v XOR (v logical-right-shift 15); v=(v*0x846ca68b) modulo 2^32; return v XOR (v logical-right-shift 16). Every integer multiply and XOR retains exactly 32 bits.
behavior.corner_hash: For integer corner (i,j): a=mix32(seed XOR u32(i) XOR 0x9e3779b9); h=mix32(a XOR u32(j) XOR 0x85ebca6b). Gradient index=h AND 7. u32 is mathematical modulo 2^32.
behavior.dot: gx*dx rounded to px; gy*dy rounded to py; px+py rounded to result. No gradient normalization. Corner order n00,n10,n01,n11 with offsets (u,v),(u-1,v),(u,v-1),(u-1,v-1); every offset subtraction separately rounded.
behavior.fade: F(t), consecutive binary64 steps: a=t*t; b=a*t; c=6*t; d=c-15; e=t*d; f=e+10; return b*f. No polynomial expansion, reassociation or FMA.
behavior.interpolation: L(a,b,t), consecutive binary64 steps: d=b-a; p=t*d; return a+p. Compute fx=F(u),fy=F(v); bottom=L(n00,n10,fx); top=L(n01,n11,fx); raw=L(bottom,top,fy); scaled=0.5*raw; result=0.5+scaled. Clamp only final result to [0,1], normalize zero to +0.
behavior.numerics: Every stated floating operation is IEEE binary64 round-to-nearest ties-to-even, separately rounded; no FMA or reassociation. Scalars compare exactly after canonical positive zero. No transcendental functions. Raw ideal bound [-1,1]; output closed interval [0,1], both endpoints possible; lattice samples exactly 0.5.
behavior.state: Pure immutable field. No RNG stream, table shuffle, host noise, time, assets, renderer, or externally mutable state. Queries may be repeated/reordered and distinct fields interleaved without changing results. Seed changes field identity; no statistical independence or cryptographic guarantee.
behavior.periodicity: Each lattice axis repeats at 2^32. Sample equality under a shifted coordinate requires that shift and fractional part be exactly representable and both queries in domain. Large coordinates lose subcell resolution; no epsilon correction. No configurable seamless tiling API.
behavior.cost: O(1) storage and query work: four corner hashes, at most eight mix32 evaluations (pure common-subexpression reuse is permitted), four dot products, fixed fades/lerps. Native sample(x,y) avoids query-array allocation. No eager full-grid sampling or hidden unbounded cache.
behavior.native_representations: Passive interchange data only, not active callbacks/accessors/proxies. Java accepts boxed Byte/Short/Integer/Long/Float/Double or native double scalars; unsupported Number subclasses are rejected before lossy coercion. Python accepts int/float but never bool; coordinates convert to binary64 before domain validation. JavaScript requires number scalars. Preserve seed integer semantics before conversion; constructor/serialization field names remain seed.

errors.INVALID_INPUT: Wrong constructor shape, unknown/missing key, bool/nonfinite/noninteger seed, or seed outside unsigned32.
errors.INVALID_QUERY: Query not exactly two finite numbers, or either floor(q) or floor(q)+1 outside safe integer range.

reproduction.acceptance: Independent coherent field marks and the public CP1 edit/transfer cases; no exact Processing field, random-stream or pelines-pixel identity claim. The four private JAVA2D probes justify design only. The JAVA2D CP1 example is validated separately in cp1_example; other hosts and source baseline suites remain unvalidated.

cp1_example.scope: Actual JAVA2D example/edit/transfer only; motivating corpus baseline suites and other hosts are not certified.

review.status: Sol approved exact semantics and independently matched all 68 scalar outputs plus mix/corner vectors; root accepted.

algorithm_sources.relationship: Gradient interpolation and quintic fade concept; no reference code or permutation copied.
